english_policy.waiver_notes: A test score is required if your four most recent years of full-time education were NOT in an English-language school system. Not required if those four years were in Canada, or in an entirely English-language school system in Canada or another country (official transcripts showing language of instruction or a hardcopy principal's letter by the document deadline), or for bilingual Francophone Canadians. ESL programs do not count. Only scores completed on or after 1 May 2025 are accepted.

english.notes: IELTS Academic; IELTS One Skill Retake accepted. An overall 7.0 with at least 6.0 in every component is also acceptable.
Old 0-120 scale, for tests completed before 21 Jan 2026. Home Edition and Paper Edition accepted; MyBest scores and TOEFL Essentials not used. Institution code 0996, department code 00.
New 1-6 scale, for tests completed as of 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 5 in writing and 5 in speaking.
PTE Academic (including PTE Academic Online): 63 overall with 65 in writing and 65 in speaking.
Tests completed after 1 July 2024: overall 120 with Literacy and Production 125; results without subscores are not accepted.
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: 180 overall with 176 in each component.
